clues.title: Landscape: tiny city-state on a coast
text: Monaco is a European **microstate** on the French Riviera, a few kilometres west of the border with Italy.

credit.licence: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0

clues.summary: A tiny coastal city-state a few kilometres from the Italian border. If you see a dense, glitzy city squeezed onto a Mediterranean hillside, think Monaco.

differs.how: Italy is far larger with plenty of rural areas

clues.title: Houses: dense luxury apartment blocks
text: Monaco is a **rich** and **densely populated** city state, with a Mediterranean feel to it. The architecture is similar to cities in southern France and northern Italy, but more luxurious. You will see a lot of apartment buildings, neoclassical details, and pastel colours. There are essentially no rural areas.

credit.licence: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0

clues.summary: Packed apartment buildings with neoclassical details and pastel colours, like southern France or northern Italy but richer. There are essentially no rural areas.

differs.how: French towns look less luxurious and have countryside nearby

clues.title: Plate: short, no blue strip
text: Monaco’s licence plates are **short** and lack the blue strip.
You will still see a lot of normal French plates around, however. These French vehicles often still have the old yellow back plates, due to how old the Generation 2 coverage is.

credit.licence: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0

clues.summary: Monaco plates are short and have no blue strip. Most cars you see are still ordinary French plates, often with old yellow rear plates because of the old Gen 2 coverage.

clues.title: Landscape: steep hills, little greenery
text: Monaco is a **hilly** country. The very few areas that are not built up show mediterranean vegetation.

credit.licence: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0

clues.summary: Very hilly ground. The few spots that are not built up show Mediterranean plants.

clues.title: Plants: planted palm trees
text: Planted **palm trees** are common.

credit.licence: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0

clues.summary: Palm trees planted along streets and in gardens are common.

clues.title: Coverage: lots of tunnels
text: There is a lot of coverage inside **tunnels**.

credit.licence: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0

clues.summary: A lot of the coverage is inside road tunnels.

clues.title: Vehicles: rows of parked mopeds
text: Rows of parked **mopeds** are a common sight around Monaco’s streets.

credit.licence: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0

clues.summary: Rows of parked mopeds line the streets, a common sight.

clues.title: Google car: trekker on a boat in the harbour
text: In the harbour, there is an extensive **Generation 3 trekker on a boat**. The Google employee’s brown hair and sunglasses are visible. You can see Monaco’s skyline and the hills beyond it. There are a lot of expensive [yachts](https://goo.gl/maps/4Z8rnvc99PPCqQEL7) around.
This trekker shows up a lot in the official competitive game modes, so it is worth remembering.

images.caption: A trekker mounted on a boat in a harbour with a city on the hillside

credit.licence: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0

clues.summary: In the harbour the camera is carried on a boat by a person with brown hair and sunglasses, with the skyline, hills and expensive yachts behind. Shows up a lot in competitive modes.
